cases.question: 哪些销售记录发生在华东地区？请按销售编号升序返回销售编号、销售日期和金额。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sale_id, sold_on, amount FROM chatbi_demo.sales WHERE region = '华东' ORDER BY sale_id

cases.question: 列出所有客户名称，并按客户编号排序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT customer_name FROM chatbi_demo.customers ORDER BY customer_id

cases.question: 所有销售记录的销售总额是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM chatbi_demo.sales

cases.question: 按地区统计销售笔数和销售总额，并按地区名称排序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS sale_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM chatbi_demo.sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

cases.question: 金额最高的两笔销售是哪两笔？按金额从高到低返回销售编号和金额。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sale_id, amount FROM chatbi_demo.sales ORDER BY amount DESC, sale_id LIMIT 2

cases.question: 2026 年 2 月 1 日之后发生了哪些销售？返回销售编号和日期。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sale_id, sold_on FROM chatbi_demo.sales WHERE sold_on >= DATE '2026-02-01' ORDER BY sale_id

cases.question: 列出每笔销售对应的客户名称和金额，并按销售编号排序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT s.sale_id, c.customer_name, s.amount FROM chatbi_demo.sales AS s JOIN chatbi_demo.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id ORDER BY s.sale_id

cases.question: 找出华东地区且金额超过 1300 的销售编号和金额。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sale_id, amount FROM chatbi_demo.sales WHERE region = '华东' AND amount > 1300 ORDER BY sale_id

cases.question: 没有填写地区的销售记录有多少条？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_region FROM chatbi_demo.sales WHERE region IS NULL

cases.question: 请用客户销售汇总找出每位客户的累计销售额，并按客户名称排序。
cases.reference_sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM chatbi_demo.sales GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.customer_name, t.total_amount FROM customer_totals AS t JOIN chatbi_demo.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id ORDER BY c.customer_name

cases.question: 销售数据中出现过哪些地区？请去重并按地区名称排序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT region FROM chatbi_demo.sales WHERE region = '华东' UNION SELECT region FROM chatbi_demo.sales WHERE region = '华南' ORDER BY region

cases.question: 销售编号为 999 的销售记录是什么？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sale_id, amount FROM chatbi_demo.sales WHERE sale_id = 999

cases.question: 销售编号 1 的金额翻倍后是多少？请使用一个清晰的结果列名。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT amount * 2 AS doubled_amount FROM chatbi_demo.sales WHERE sale_id = 1

cases.question: 哪位客户的累计销售额最高？请给出客户名称和累计金额。
cases.reference_sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM chatbi_demo.sales GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.customer_name, t.total_amount FROM customer_totals AS t JOIN chatbi_demo.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id ORDER BY t.total_amount DESC, c.customer_name LIMIT 1

cases.question: 哪些地区在 2026 年 2 月前后都出现过销售？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT region FROM chatbi_demo.sales WHERE sold_on < DATE '2026-02-01' INTERSECT SELECT region FROM chatbi_demo.sales WHERE sold_on >= DATE '2026-02-01' ORDER BY region

cases.question: 用两个时间范围的查询合并得到所有出现过的销售地区，并去重。
cases.reference_sql: WITH early AS (SELECT region FROM chatbi_demo.sales WHERE sold_on < DATE '2026-02-01'), late AS (SELECT region FROM chatbi_demo.sales WHERE sold_on >= DATE '2026-02-01') SELECT region FROM early UNION SELECT region FROM late ORDER BY region
